title: Warlords of New York Manhunt
summary: The Lower Manhattan campaign that sends SHD Agents after Aaron Keener following the biological attack attributed to him.

claims.text: Ubisoft's Warlords of New York overview says SHD Agents are sent to Lower Manhattan after a biological attack to hunt Aaron Keener and stop further attacks.
The same official overview describes five investigation threads that link main and side missions, including five main missions and eight side missions.

paragraphs.text: The Warlords campaign is framed as SHD's response to the Lower Manhattan attack: Agents pursue Keener through an open-ended campaign whose investigation threads connect the main and side missions.

timeline.label: After the Lower Manhattan attack — SHD begins the Warlords manhunt

verification.notes: This record covers the officially described campaign setup and structure, not a claim that the archive has complete collectible or dialogue coverage.
